## What these results do not show

- All data is synthetic. No result generalises to production telemetry.
- Risk scores are relative orderings, not calibrated failure probabilities.
- Outcome capture records what was observed, never what was caused.
- Identity confidence is an input, not computed here.
- The observation log is append-only in-process, not cryptographically chained.
- A correction must name the reading it supersedes; unannounced corrections arriving under a new id are not inferred.
- Entitlement records a rights determination made elsewhere; this code does not interpret contracts or determine legal rights.
- Release authority is a single global confidence floor, not scaled to the economic consequence of the claim.
- Digests are SHA-256 throughout but computed by four different digest-input constructions depending on the field -- see docs/PORTABILITY_CONTRACT.md.
